archival_memory.diabetes_treatment: Metformin 1000 mg twice daily for several years. Added semaglutide(Ozempic) at low dose. A1C around 6.9%. Fasting blood sugar typically 125-130 mg/dL. Noted improvement in appetite control with semaglutide.
archival_memory.hypertension_treatment: Losartan 50 mg once daily. Blood pressure range: 135-140/80-90 mmHg. Doctor recommends stress management and reduced sodium intake instead of increasing dosage. Taking daily magnesium supplement for potential blood pressure support.
archival_memory.hypothyroidism_treatment: Levothyroxine 75 mcg daily, taken on empty stomach, 30 minutes before eating. Last TSH: 2.1 mIU/L(within normal range). Doctor has not changed dosage in years. Notice sluggishness if a dose is missed; uses pill organizer to stay on track.
archival_memory.osteoarthritis_treatment: Acetaminophen as needed for mild pain. Meloxicam 7.5 mg prescribed for flare-ups(knees and hands), taken only when joints are stiff. Avoids daily NSAID use to minimize side effects. Glucosamine supplements tried, but unsure of effectiveness.
archival_memory.vitamin_d_and_bone_health: Vitamin D3 2,000 IU daily due to low levels(22 ng/mL; normal >30 ng/mL). Taking calcium supplements due to early osteopenia on bone density scan. Doctor recommends combining with vitamin K2 to improve calcium absorption and bone health.
archival_memory.cholesterol_management: Atorvastatin 10 mg daily. Initial LDL: 130 mg/dL, triglycerides: 140 mg/dL. Started low-dose statin to improve lipid profile. Cholesterol levels have improved, no reported side effects(e.g., muscle aches).
archival_memory.general_health_supplements: Daily multivitamin, omega-3 supplements for heart health, probiotics for digestion. Takes digestive enzymes after meals with heavier or fatty foods due to gallbladder removal. Aware that gallbladder removal affects fat digestion and now mindful of dietary fat intake.
archival_memory.medication_interactions: Aware of potential interactions: NSAIDs(meloxicam) can affect kidney function when combined with losartan(an ACE inhibitor), so limits meloxicam use to flare-ups only. Takes levothyroxine separately from calcium and iron supplements to avoid interference with absorption.
